wiki.title: Craig Bowser
wiki.extract: Craig Bowser is an American politician serving as a member of the Kansas Senate from the 1st district. A member of the Republican Party, he defeated incumbent senator Dennis Pyle, who served as an Independent from 2022 to 2024, in the party's primary election in the 2024 Kansas Senate election. He was previously an information security officer with the State of Kansas and served in the U.S. Army Reserve.
